hook: Cyberabad Moves mobility event at T-Hub, *Nov 26-28*
hook_b: Cyberabad Moves mobility event at T-Hub, *Nov 26-28*
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy launched the poster for Cyberabad Moves 2026, a three-day event on road safety, sustainable transport and mobility solutions, at T-Hub, Raidurgam, from Nov 26 to 28, 9 am to 6 pm.

beats.what: Cyberabad Moves 2026 will be held at T-Hub, Raidurgam.
beats.why: Cyberabad's mobility needs are growing, officials say.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 19): CMC Commissioner G. Srijana urged people to register and take part.

cards.q: What's the biggest commute problem in Cyberabad?

qs: Which Cyberabad roads would you bring to this event?

facts.t: Sessions run *9 am to 6 pm* each day at T-Hub, Raidurgam.

viz.verdict: Open to citizens, students and industry

watch: Event runs Nov 26-28, 9 am to 6 pm, at T-Hub.
fact: Cyberabad Moves invites citizens to T-Hub on *Nov 26-28* to fix commutes
twist: Students and residents can register to pitch ideas, not just officials and industry.
